packageRules.description: @aws-sdk/middleware-websocket keeps a caret range, the same kind pi-ai's @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime asks for, so npm and pnpm resolve one copy for both and the aws-websocket-abort-signal patch reaches the class the Bedrock client uses.

The kernel, pnpm, slicc-cdp and the wasm command packages move only after the homescoop coordinator certifies them, as in slicc-bios, so Renovate opens their PRs but never merges them; a PR merges once the cert lane has certified that version. The kernel and wasm-* devDependencies are the versions CI tests.

Chord 1.3 changes the link protocol, so moving to it is the agent 6.0 port, done by hand; until then Renovate keeps @earendil-works/chord on 1.2.x. pi-durable 1.3 nests its own Chord 1.3, which only its state and context layer uses (npm run lint:chord).
